# Every repo-backed command runs the git-integration nudge, which reads
# `git --version`. Without git on $PATH there is no version to compare against -
# that has to degrade to "no config-based hooks", not take the command down.

exec git init
exec git config user.email test@sesam.dev
exec git config user.name 'Sesam Test'

exec sesam init --user admin
exec git add -A
exec git commit -m 'init sesam'

# hide-git keeps only the directory holding the sesam test binary on $PATH.
hide-git
! exec git --version

exec sesam status
stdout 'in sync'
stderr 'failed to figure out git --version'

exec sesam log
stdout 'initialized repo'
